subject: Coverage plan for Search Infra: interim lead + pending reviews
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tara Klein <tara.k@peopleops.co>, Compass HR <engage@compass-hr.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Coverage plan for Search Infra: interim lead + pending reviews

Team —

Quick heads-up: Dev has accepted an internal transfer to Edge Platform (effective 11/30). He shared the news with his reports last week. Im copying PeopleOps (Tara/Compass) because there are a couple of sensitive items that need HR support and formal documentation.

We need an interim manager in place starting 11/16 to ensure we dont miss the end-of-quarter performance check-ins (some had already been scheduled). My recommendation is to appoint Monica as interim lead for Search Infra through the end of Q1 (formal timeframe to be decided), and to route comp/role approvals through Marissa while the handoff is in progress.

Action items Im proposing now:
- Marissa: can you confirm org-level approvals needed to make Monica interim (comp sign-off, budget holder)?
- Monica: can you confirm youre available to take on interim responsibilities starting 11/16?
- Tara / Compass HR: please prepare a short appointment memo and any required paperwork for Devs transfer and Monicas temporary assignment.
- Dev: please attach your transition notes and any outstanding 1:1/feedback docs to the shared drive link below by EOD 11/12.

Ive attached a lightweight org chart and a draft transition plan to help frame the conversation. The team has a couple of sensitive PIP/close-monitoring cases — Ive flagged them in the doc (private comments) and will coordinate offline with PeopleOps.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/document/d/1xYzDraftTransition
Attachments: org_chart_v2.pdf, search_infra_transition_plan.docx

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tara Klein <tara.k@peopleops.co>, Compass HR <engage@compass-hr.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage plan for Search Infra: interim lead + pending reviews

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 9:04 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads-up: Dev has accepted an internal transfer to Edge Platform (effective 11/30). He shared the news with his reports last week...

Thanks for the summary, Jonas. I support appointing Monica as interim subject to a couple of operational confirmations:

1) Budget/comp approvals: We need written approval from Finance for any headcount reclassification if Monicas interim title would change comp bands. If this is purely a temporary assignment (no comp change), we can avoid the formal comp route, but Finance should be notified.

2) Performance reviews: We have three direct reports in Search Infra with reviews scheduled week of 11/22. We should decide whether those go ahead with Monica as reviewer or whether we postpone until Devs transfer is final. Given the risk of delayed calibration if we postpone, my preference is to proceed with Monica as reviewer and loop in calibration panel.

3) Sensitive cases: Please confirm the list of employees on PIP or sensitive remediation. Ill need to ensure theres an HR business partner on any conversation and that notes are preserved in Workday.

If Monica can confirm availability, Ill start the approvals stream and notify Finance.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tara Klein <tara.k@peopleops.co>, Compass HR <engage@compass-hr.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage plan for Search Infra: interim lead + pending reviews

Thanks for the ask. I can take interim lead responsibility starting 11/16 through at least the end of Q1, pending formal sign-off. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Scope: Id like the interim scope to include day-to-day people management, hiring intake triage, and running the weekly engineering sync. Im not expecting to sign off on long-term promotions or compensation changes without Marissas sign-off.
- Reviews: Im happy to run the scheduled check-ins (week of 11/22) provided PeopleOps confirms calibration panel membership and access to historical review notes.
- Access & approvals: I will need manager-level access in our HR system for the interim period (Workday) and temp approvals in PagerDuty for on-call rotations.

Ill add my suggested 10-day transition checklist to the shared Drive and can meet with Dev next week to go through status and runbooks. Dev — appreciate any notes you can drop into the doc by 11/12.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Engineering Manager, Search
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Klein <tara.k@peopleops.co>, Compass HR <engage@compass-hr.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage plan for Search Infra: interim lead + pending reviews

Thanks everyone — Laura here. Im approving Monica as interim lead effective 11/16. A few governance items from leadership: 

- Formalize the interim assignment: Tara / Compass, please draft the appointment memo (term, reporting, any comp notes) and send to Legal for a 1 business-day review.
- Reviews: Proceed with the week-of-11/22 check-ins with Monica as the reviewer. Marissa, please add Monica to the calibration panel and share any calibration notes by 11/20 so we can finalize comp guidance.
- Sensitive PIP cases: Jonas, please send a private list to Tara (copy only) and do not include in any shared folder comments. HR will triage next steps and set up 1:1s where appropriate.
- Systems access: IT/PeopleOps action: grant Monica manager-level access and temporary PagerDuty approvals.

Jonas — please confirm once Dev has uploaded transition notes and when HR has the memo ready; Ill announce to the organization after paperwork is in place.

Best,
Laura Bennett
SVP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
